correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the finite-interval distance as F_b(qb+r)=q+min(ceil(r/2),1+ceil((b-r)/2)), with positive-step and overshoot-backtrack constructions respecting interval boundaries. F_b(d+b)=F_b(d)+1 and the explicit k-dependent residue pair table show injective signatures from {0,1,2k+1}, including special i=0 and 1<=i<2k+1 cases. For lower bound, all interior vertices have degree>=4, so a 2-landmark basis can only be the two degree-3 endpoints; when n=b+2 vertices 1,b collide, and when n>=b+3 six vertices at distance 2 to left endpoint have at most five second-coordinate distances. Independent separately written BFS checked 276,612 ordered graph distances across 4k+1 jumps k=3..14 and diverse n, resolution and endpoint-pair failure; infinite claim follows from the proof, not the experiment.

evidence: The first establishes even b and conjectures odd; second treats jumps 3..6.
